title: Next.js for Beginners
shortDescription: Learn the basics of Next.js and build modern React apps.
description: This course teaches the fundamentals of Next.js including routing, server components, API routes, and deployment. By the end, you will build and deploy a real-world project.

title: React Mastery
shortDescription: Become confident building advanced React applications.
description: This course covers React hooks, context API, performance optimization, and component architecture to help you build scalable applications.

title: MongoDB for Developers
shortDescription: Understand MongoDB database design and operations.
description: Learn how to design schemas, perform CRUD operations, create indexes, and connect MongoDB with modern web applications.

title: Full Stack Web Development
shortDescription: Build complete web applications from frontend to backend.
description: This course teaches React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB so you can create full stack web applications and deploy them to production.

title: UI/UX Design Fundamentals
shortDescription: Learn the basics of user interface and user experience design.
description: Understand design principles, wireframing, prototyping, and user-centered design to create better digital experiences.

title: JavaScript Advanced Concepts
shortDescription: Master closures, promises, async programming and more.
description: Dive deep into JavaScript internals and learn advanced techniques used by professional developers.

title: Node.js Backend Development
shortDescription: Build scalable backend APIs using Node.js and Express.
description: Learn REST API development, authentication, middleware, and database integration using Node.js.

title: TypeScript Complete Guide
shortDescription: Learn TypeScript to write safer and scalable JavaScript.
description: This course covers types, interfaces, generics, and advanced TypeScript features used in large projects.

title: Responsive Web Design
shortDescription: Create websites that work perfectly on all devices.
description: Learn CSS Flexbox, Grid, media queries, and modern responsive techniques to design mobile-friendly websites.
